purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for Nevada 2024 result, review, turnout, CVR, audit, L&A, tabulator-log, custody, equipment, and incident/correction source paths. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.
authorityPriority: Official state and county election sources first; secondary sources are context only and caveated.

caveats: The live NVSOS/Silver State page returned an Incapsula challenge from this environment on 2026-07-01.
The archived official page contains county columns, but no precinct, CSV, Excel, export, registered-voter, or turnout markers were found in the page markup checked on 2026-07-01.
County U.S. Senate rows are same county grain as the certified presidential rows, but they are not local/precinct reporting-unit review rows.
Normalized precinct aggregate only; the raw Clark County CVR ZIP is not committed.
County CVR aggregates can differ from certified county totals and are review context rather than replacement certified totals.
Normalized precinct aggregate only; the raw Washoe County CVR CSV is not committed.
County CVR aggregates can differ from certified county totals and are review context rather than replacement certified totals.
Official county CVR is normalized to precinct President-versus-U.S. Senate review rows; it is not a replacement for certified county totals.
The official Humboldt page also links Statement of Votes Cast Excel/PDF and canvass/abstract files, but this pass only normalized the CVR because it matched the existing Nevada CVR layout.
National EAC fallback turnout rows remain configured because a state-native Nevada county turnout denominator artifact was not collected in this pass.
Live Nevada SOS turnout and registration pages returned Incapsula challenge pages or empty responses from this environment on 2026-07-01.

remainingLocalReviewGaps.neededArtifact: Official precinct/local reporting-unit President and U.S. Senate rows or official CVR/SOV exports that can be normalized to the same local grain.
remainingLocalReviewGaps.sourceSideBlocker: No single statewide Nevada precinct/local President plus U.S. Senate export was identified. Live NVSOS/Silver State pages are script-blocked from this environment. County-by-county official exports or public-records productions are still needed for the remaining 14 jurisdictions.

sourceChecks.finding: Live pages returned Incapsula challenge pages, zero-length content, or transport errors from scripted access; no state-native turnout denominator artifact was collected.

equipment.caveat: Jurisdiction-level election-administration context only; not a vote, turnout, audit, or incident dataset.

cvr.caveat: Loaded CVR-derived rows are normalized precinct aggregates for review context. Other counties still need official CVR availability checks or records-request productions.

audit.caveat: No normalized 2024 Nevada post-election audit selection, scope, discrepancy, or outcome artifact is loaded. Request Secretary of State and county audit records before treating audit context as loaded.

logicAccuracy.caveat: No normalized 2024 Nevada L&A test deck, notice, result, or machine acceptance artifact is loaded.

tabulatorLogs.caveat: No normalized Nevada tabulator, EMS, adjudication, upload, or removable-media log artifact is loaded.

custody.caveat: No normalized chain-of-custody artifact for ballots, equipment, or media is loaded.

incidentsCorrections.caveat: No normalized 2024 Nevada incident, correction, recount, or litigation dataset is loaded.

nextActions: Collect or request official precinct/local President and U.S. Senate rows, CVRs, or SOV exports for the remaining 14 Nevada jurisdictions listed in remainingJurisdictionSourceMatrix.
Prioritize reachable official county pages with result/resource exports before records requests, then use the Nevada SOS county-clerk contact path for blocked or non-exporting counties.
Collect a state-native county or precinct turnout denominator artifact if Nevada publishes one outside the blocked live SOS pages.
Inventory and normalize audit, CVR availability, tabulator-log, L&A, custody, incident, correction, recount, and litigation artifacts separately from vote-result rows.
Replace secondary 2012/2016/2020 historical baseline rows with official Nevada SOS historical exports if a script-readable or records-request-produced artifact is obtained.
